subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: After the history-stability and authority defect is fixed, should DeepSeek handling be internal provider policy or a permanent public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` option with an explicit-false override?
rationale: The request shape can be repaired mechanically, but repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding a lasting config/default surface that changes existing provider payload semantics.

options.title: Internal DeepSeek policy
options.body: Keep the proven DeepSeek-specific payload strategy internal and avoid adding another public compatibility knob.

options.title: Public compatibility option
options.body: Retain the config field and automatic DeepSeek default, with focused fresh-install, upgrade, explicit-false, and custom-endpoint proof.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the provider behavior if neither an internal default nor a supported public override is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Internal DeepSeek policy
recommendation.body: Keep the proven DeepSeek-specific payload strategy internal and avoid adding another public compatibility knob.

likelyOwner.reason: The cache-boundary feature and affected compatibility seam originate in their merged work, making them the strongest evidence-backed decision owner.
